answer: At each epoch close, every identity answers one gust challenge in the same minute, so no device can serve two names. Each name mounts one hand-spun rotor in a numbered meadow slot and locks $35 for 60 days. A sealed relic card records that rotor's drag curve; any peer can rerun the standard zephyr blast and compare live spin-up against the card in 3 seconds. A swapped rotor misses its curve; that mismatch, posted with both readings, cancels the slot and burns the lock. One honest agent pays $35 once; 1,000 fakes need 1,000 rotors and $35,000, since that minute leaves no rotor to answer twice.
